title: Challenges
sub: Short games to try at your own pace.

video.name: Focus for a Moment
video.desc: An oasis scene that changes every time, then questions about what you saw.
video.purpose: A short attention exercise for a spare moment.
video.instructions: You'll watch a 24-second oasis scene. Watch the details, then I'll ask you about it.

mem.name: What Do You Remember?
mem.desc: Memorize the things and their colors, then tell me what vanished.
mem.purpose: Visual memory rounds that gradually get harder.
mem.instructions: Memorize the things and their colors, then tell me what vanished.

seq.name: Plan Your Day
seq.desc: Sort today's tasks: what's for now and what's for later.
seq.purpose: Arranges your own tasks, the ones you write or today's goals.
seq.instructions: Write what's on your plate, or take it from your goals, then put each under now, later or not today.

time.name: Where Did the Time Go?
time.desc: Guess the duration, then compare it with the actual time.
time.purpose: See the gap between how time feels and how long it took.
time.instructions: Estimate how many seconds a simple task will take, then we'll compare.

calm.name: Take It Easy
calm.desc: Calm breathing your way, for a minute or more, or quiet without breathing.
calm.purpose: A quiet pause in your day, and you can skip it.
calm.instructions: Breathe with me at your own pace, or take a break without breathing. Your call.

start2.name: Just Two Minutes
start2.desc: Pick a task you keep putting off and start its smallest step.
start2.purpose: Helps you begin a delayed task with one small step.
start2.instructions: We'll pick a delayed task and start it with one small step.

attention_scene.name: What Changed?
attention_scene.desc: Compare two scenes and spot the differences.
attention_scene.purpose: Attention to detail, with no rush.
attention_scene.instructions: Here are two scenes. In the second one, tap what changed.

priority_board.name: What Comes First?
priority_board.desc: Sort your tasks into now, later and not today.
priority_board.purpose: Lightens the load when everything feels important.
priority_board.instructions: Sort the tasks into three lists, then pick what comes first. There's no wrong answer.

breakdown.name: Break It Down
breakdown.desc: Split a big task into small steps and make a plan.
breakdown.purpose: Turns a big task into a clear first step.
breakdown.instructions: Write down a big task, split it into small steps, and make a simple plan.

study_sprint.name: Focus Sprint
study_sprint.desc: A short focus session for any task, with a place to park distractions.
study_sprint.purpose: A short focus session for study, work or any task.
study_sprint.instructions: Pick a length that suits you and start. Note down anything distracting, then come back.

emotion_map.name: How Are You Feeling?
emotion_map.desc: Choose how you feel and what might help, in your own terms.
emotion_map.purpose: An optional pause to note how you feel, in your own terms.
emotion_map.instructions: Choose how you feel right now, if you want to. I don't guess your feelings. This is your answer.

calm_landscape.name: A Break Your Way
calm_landscape.desc: A short break for what you need: your eyes, moving, quiet or a busy mind.
calm_landscape.purpose: A short break between tasks, shaped by what you need right now.
calm_landscape.instructions: Pick what you need right now, and I'll take it from there.

micro_start.name: Just the First Step
micro_start.desc: Shrink the first step of a task until it feels easy, then try it.
micro_start.purpose: Makes starting smaller when a task feels too big to begin.
micro_start.instructions: Pick a task, write its first step or shrink one until it feels doable, then try it with a 2-minute timer or none.

thought_sort.name: Let's Think It Through
thought_sort.desc: Sort what's on your mind into what you can act on, what's uncertain and what can wait.
thought_sort.purpose: Helps you see which worries have a next step and which you can set down for now.
thought_sort.instructions: Write down what is on your mind, sort each one, then choose one small next step if you like. It is saved in your private account.

dhikr_morning.name: Start your day with dhikr
dhikr_morning.desc: Morning adhkar with a counter, each with its source.
dhikr_morning.purpose: The established morning adhkar, with their text, source and number of times.
dhikr_morning.instructions: Read each dhikr and tap the counter each time you say it. When the count is reached you move on, and you can skip any of them.

dhikr_evening.name: End your day with dhikr
dhikr_evening.desc: Evening adhkar with a counter, each with its source.
dhikr_evening.purpose: The established evening adhkar, with their text, source and number of times.
dhikr_evening.instructions: Read each dhikr and tap the counter each time you say it. When the count is reached you move on, and you can skip any of them.

dhikr_calm_heart.name: Ease your heart
dhikr_calm_heart.desc: Established supplications for worry and distress, at your own pace.
dhikr_calm_heart.purpose: Established supplications and dhikr for worry, distress and fear.
dhikr_calm_heart.instructions: Read each supplication slowly and tap the counter when you say it. There is no timer, and you can skip any of them.

dhikr_moment.name: Take a moment of dhikr
dhikr_moment.desc: A minute of remembrance between tasks.
dhikr_moment.purpose: A short pause with established remembrance from the Sunnah.
dhikr_moment.instructions: Say the dhikr as many times as you like; the counter keeps count. Move on whenever you want.

dhikr_sleep.name: Before you sleep
dhikr_sleep.desc: Bedtime adhkar, quietly, with no sounds or celebration.
dhikr_sleep.purpose: The established bedtime adhkar, with their text, source and number of times.
dhikr_sleep.instructions: Read each dhikr and tap the counter gently. Everything here stays quiet to help you wind down.

grounding.name: What's Around You?
grounding.desc: 5 things you see, 4 you touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste.
grounding.purpose: Brings your attention back to where you are, and can calm you a little.
grounding.instructions: Look around for each thing we ask about, and tap each time you find one. It's fine if you don't.

eye_break.name: My eyes are tired
eye_break.desc: A 20-second break for your eyes, away from the screen.
eye_break.purpose: The 20-20-20 habit: after a long time on a screen, look at something far away for 20 seconds.
eye_break.instructions: Tap start and look at something far from you for 20 seconds. The timer runs by itself, and you can pause and resume it.

eye_rest.name: Rest Your Eyes
eye_rest.desc: Look at something far away for 20 seconds and rest your eyes from the screen.
eye_rest.purpose: A short pause that rests your eyes after a long time at a screen.
eye_rest.instructions: Look at something far away, a window or the far end of the room, until the timer ends.

groupLabel: What do you want to do now?

say.all: What do you feel like doing? Pick what suits you.
say.focus: Let's wake up and focus a little.
say.calm: Take a breath. Easy does it.
say.think: Let's think it through, at our own pace.
